image_description: A street scene featuring a green metal pole with multiple traffic lights attached. The central focus is a vertical traffic light with an illuminated amber signal at the top. Below it are unlit signals. To the left, another traffic light hangs horizontally. In the background, there is a white multi-story building and bare trees against an overcast sky. There are also banners attached to the pole.
